description: ALGAMEST is a team of creative young minds passionate about space, science, and technology. We believe that learning about space should be exciting and interactive. Through innovation, teamwork, and AI-powered development, we aim to turn complex space missions into fun and educational experiences.
summary: In our project we wanted to show people how the rocket projects works.Because people always see the improvements about the space rockets but they don't see how important and hard it is.When we saw this competition about it we didn't even hesitated and joined it.So in our project we showed how do the NASA or ESA scientist make rockets and how much does it cost in a understandable way.
details: This project is about a simulation of a rocket space mission in a realistic way. In the simulation we are making a rocket with a plan and at the last we made it to the moon.It helps us to understand the important things about making a rocket like piece costs,pieces we needed and more.We used HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript in our project. This project is a one in one because in these days people are more obsessed with strategic games and our game combines strategy and space mission together.In the project we considered rocket's weight, cost, power and safety.
